description: This file is a shell script for testing HTTP authentication header parsing and credential helper interaction using a custom testing framework. It sets up various test cases for different HTTP authentication mechanisms, such as Basic, Bearer, and Multistage authentication, by mocking server responses and verifying credential exchanges.

methods.name: set_credential_reply
methods.description: Defines a credential reply file content by writing credentials into a specified file.

methods.name: expect_credential_query
methods.description: Compares the actual credential query output with the expected credentials.

methods.name: per_test_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up credential files and authentication artifacts after each test.
